name: Lakeside Kubb
summary:
Lakeside Kubb brings the classic Scandinavian lawn game to VR. You stand on a mown pitch on an autumn meadow by a mountain lake, with ten kubbs, the king and six wooden batons, just like in a garden game with friends.

HOW TO PLAY
- Throw your batons underarm to knock over the kubbs on your opponent's baseline.
- Your opponent throws the kubbs you knocked over into your half, and has to knock these field kubbs over first.
- Once all of the other side's kubbs are down, topple the king to win. Topple him too
